description: Header file defining the QConvoneDNN class with static methods for quantized convolution operations in PyTorch's ATen library.

classes.name: QConvoneDNN
classes.description: A class providing static methods for performing quantized convolution operations in PyTorch.

methods.name: run_pointwise
methods.description: Performs a pointwise quantized convolution operation with tensor inputs.

methods.name: run_pointwise_tensor
methods.description: Performs a pointwise quantized convolution operation with tensor inputs for scales and zero points.

methods.name: run_pointwise_binary
methods.description: Performs a binary pointwise quantized operation, possibly for element-wise binary functions.

methods.name: run_pointwise_binary_tensor
methods.description: Performs a binary pointwise quantized operation with tensor inputs for scales and zero points.
